_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Reading the weather on the course…

description: What the weather will be like for a cycling or running event, for the people taking part: "What will the weather be like for the NYC Marathon?", "Weather for the Comrades demo?". Within 10 days of the start: the live forecast (Apple Weather) along the course at the times the riders or runners get to each stretch, with the Windline forecast engine's rating (Good, Fair, Tough) and why, the headwind and tailwind stretches, heat stress and rain. Further out: 10 years of weather on that date (Copernicus ERA5), clearly labelled as history, not a forecast. With a map of the course coloured by the wind or the heat, and a link to the event's livedot page. If several events match it lists them: ask which one. Only for named events and races. Not for the user's own route or GPX file; for those use plan_route.

event.description: The event's name, e.g. "NYC Marathon", "Gravel Burn", "Comrades demo".

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

year.description: The edition's year, if the user named one.

name: event_weather

outputSchema.description: The weather for an event along its course, rated by the Windline forecast engine.

basis.description: forecast (Apple Weather, within 10 days), historic (10 years of Copernicus ERA5 on that date) or mixed.

days.description: Each day: name, date (ISO), basis, rating (good, fair, tough), why, start_temp_c, finish_temp_c, effort_pct (cycling), heat_stress and wbgt_c (running), rain_mm or rain_days_in_10 and usual_high_c.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

events.description: Several events matched: their names. Ask the user which one.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

timed_for.description: What the times assume (the start, the pace).

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Race-day weather for an event
